question: What supreme phase is reached upon ascending the ground of the trident?
premises: One ascends the ground of the trident connected with the three channels.
There is a supreme phase that is present in all, pervading all, and life-giving to all.
Ascending that ground gives access to that supreme phase.
inference: Therefore by ascending the trident-ground connected with the three channels, one reaches the supreme all-pervading, all-vivifying phase.
plain_english: Having ascended the ground of the trident, connected with the three channels, one reaches the supreme phase that is present in all, pervading all, and life-giving to all.
